When you take photos with the phone, they are always shown in the Google Photos app on that phone. It does not matter whether they are backed up or not.

If your photos and videos are still in the Google Photos Trash, you can restore them by going to Google Photos → Collections → Trash, selecting the items, and tapping Restore.
Backed-up items generally remain in Trash for 60 days, while items that weren't backed up generally remain for 30 days. If you permanently deleted them from Trash or emptied the Trash, Google Photos generally cannot restore them.
Can you tell us when you deleted the photos/videos and whether they are still visible in Trash? That will help determine what recovery options are available.

Hi there,
 
If you recently deleted photos or videos, please first check the Trash/Bin in Google Photos:
 
• Open the Google Photos app on your Android Device
• Tap Collections > Trash
• Select the items you want to restore and tap Restore
 
Backed up photos and videos stay in Trash for 60 days, while items not backed up remain for 30 days. After this period, they are permanently deleted and may not be recoverable. You may also try the automated recovery tool for backed up photos and videos: Click the recovery process button to submit a recovery request: Recovery process to recently deleted photos & videos
 
The recovery process is a best-effort attempt to restore photos and videos deleted within the last few days. Please note that not all deleted content can be recovered. If the recovery attempt is unsuccessful, there are no further recovery options available.


Check your email for confirmation and recovery updates.
If successful, recovered items will appear in Trash or Locked Folder.
 
You can find more information here: Restore your photos & videos.
 
Good Luck! Thanks.

Hello,


Welcome to the Google Photos Help Forum!
 
Important: You can only restore photos and videos if they’re still in your trash. You won't be able to restore a photo or video if:
You moved it to trash more than 60 days ago.
You moved it to trash, then emptied your trash.
You permanently deleted it from your trash.
Restore recently deleted photos & videos (Android)
On your Android device, open the Google Photos app .
At the bottom, tap Library  Trash .
Touch and hold the photo or video you want to restore.
If the photo or video isn’t in your trash, it may be permanently deleted.
At the bottom, tap Restore. Your photo or video will be back in:
Albums that it was in
Google Photos library
Phone’s gallery app
 
You may also Check your archive
If your missing item is archived, you can unarchive it so it shows in your Google Photos library. Learn how to check your archive and unarchive items.
Not all deleted photos & videos can be restored
 
For more information about attempting Photo and Video Recovery recovery: https://support.google.com/photos/answer/9343482
 
Hope this helps!
 
 
Best,
Finch

Hi there,
 
If you recently deleted photos or videos, please first check the Trash/Bin in Google Photos:
 
• Open the Google Photos app on your Android Device
• Tap Collections > Trash
• Select the items you want to restore and tap Restore
 
Backed up photos and videos stay in Trash for 60 days, while items not backed up remain for 30 days. After this period, they are permanently deleted and may not be recoverable. You may also try the automated recovery tool for backed up photos and videos: Click the recovery process button to submit a recovery request: Recovery process to recently deleted photos & videos
 
The recovery process is a best-effort attempt to restore photos and videos deleted within the last few days. Please note that not all deleted content can be recovered. If the recovery attempt is unsuccessful, there are no further recovery options available.


Check your email for confirmation and recovery updates.
If successful, recovered items will appear in Trash or Locked Folder.
 
You can find more information here: Restore your photos & videos.
 
Good Luck! Thanks.
